info.name: Brightloop Subscription Management API - Test Suite
info.description:
End-to-end and negative test cases for the Brightloop Subscription Management API.

Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or newman). Every request carries its own assertions, including a response-time check (< 2 s). Requires the demo seed (python scripts/seed_demo.py), which creates admin@brightloop.demo / Strong#Pass1.
